title: Set up an NFC tag
intro: Share your business card by tapping an NFC tag with a smartphone.
cardUrl: Card URL to write to the NFC tag:
buyHint: Choose a writable NFC tag (NTAG213 or NTAG215). You can use an NFC sticker, card or wristband. Typical price: €0.50–€2.00 per tag.
installHint: Install an app on your smartphone that can write to NFC tags:
write: Write the URL to the tag
paste: Paste the card URL shown above.
tap: Tap “Write” and hold the tag near your smartphone.
testHint: Hold a smartphone near the tag. The card opens in the browser without an app. NFC is supported on iPhone 7 and later and Android 4.4 and later.
androidTools: NFC Tools or NFC TagWriter by NXP
